Mind ko success ka home banao.
"Great work ka way: usse pyaar."
"Great ke liye good chhodne se mat dar."
"Jo matter karta, uske liye time do."
Sirf paani dekhne se samandar paar nahi hota.
"Mind powerfull servant bhi, terrible master bhi."
Success ke baad failure ka intezar mat karo.
Failure feedback hai, defeat nahi.
"Perfect nahi, progress pe focus karo."
"Challenges life ko interesting banate—unko overcome karke meaningful."
Failures ko define mat hone do.
Ghadi ko mat dekho; uski tarah karo—lagataar chalte raho.
